## Turbo.constructor

[Implementation, line 50](powertrain.ts#L50)

Turbo on that same engine. A sine whistle plus a slice of the shared noise.
No new nodes per gear change. A hard drop in load vents the stored boost once:
that is the short shift cut. The whistle fades out as rpm rises.

## VehicleAudio.constructor

[Implementation, line 24](vehicle.ts#L24)

One browser audio context, four independent voices.

The context has to be created from a click or a key press (`unlock`).
Turbine, propeller, tires and powertrain each own their nodes; they only
share that context and one noise buffer. Studio owns the mute button.
Audio never throws into the host loop.

```ts
constructor(enabled = true): instance
```
